title: fix: resolve /presentation 404 by adding routes to _redirects
body:
## Summary

`/presentation` returns a 404 (SPA catch-all) on production because Netlify processes `public/_redirects` **before** `netlify.toml` redirects. The `_redirects` file had only `/* /index.html 200`, which matched `/presentation` and served the SPA's index.html instead of the static presentation.

Fix: add `/presentation` and `/presentation/*` rules to `_redirects` before the catch-all, matching what's already in `netlify.toml`.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/ee868d7573934f83923e5701415e1903
Requested by: @Govmatchai
